Technical
Specifications
Chassis and body Engine Drivetrain Tank Capacities
Frame Carbon fiber monocoque with aluminum front and rear frames. Type V12, 60°, MPI . Type of transmission 4WD with Haldex generation IV. Fuel tank 90 litres (23.77 US gallons, 19.79 UK gallons).
Body Carbon fiber engine bonnet, front fenders and doors; SMC rear Displacement 6498 cc (396.5 cu. in). Gearbox 7 speed ISR, shifting characteristic depending on drive Engine oil 13 litres (3.43 US gallons, 2.86 UK gallons).
fender and rocker cover; High pressure RTM carbon fiber Hard Bore and stroke Ø 95 mm x 76.4 mm (3.74 in x 3.01 in). select mode. Engine coolant 25 litres (6.60 US gallons, 5.50 UK gallons).
Top matt black painted. Valve gear Variable valve timing electronically controlled. Standard AMT.
Consumption**
Suspension Front and rear horizontal mono-tube damper with push-rod system. Compression ratio 11.8 ± 0.2. Clutch Dry double plate clutch, Ø 235 mm (9.25 in).
Combined '16 l/100 km
ESP ESP/ ABS with different ESP characteristics managed by drive Maximum power 700 PS* (515 kW) at 8250 rpm.
Performance CO emission 370 g/km
select mode. Maximum torque 690 Nm (509 ft-lb) at 5500 rpm. 2
Top speed 350 km/h (217 mph).
Brakes Dual hydraulic circuit brake system with vacuum brake booster; Emission class EURO 5 - LEV 2.
Acceleration 0–100 km/h 3 seconds. *The horsepower (hp) can be calculated as follows: 1 kW = 1,34 hp
front and rear CCB. Emission control system Catalytic converters with lambda sensors.
**In accordance with Dir. EC/1999/100
(0–62 mph)
Ventilated discs (front) Ø 400 x 38 mm (15.74 x 1.49 in) 6 pistons (calipers). Cooling system Water and oil cooling system in the rear with variable air inlets.
Ventilated discs (rear) Ø 380 x 38 mm (14.96 x 1.49 in) 4 pistons (calipers). Engine management system Lamborghini Iniezione Elettronica (LIE) with ion current analysis. Dimensions
Steering Steering Gear with 3 different servotronic characteristics managed Lubrication system Dry sump. Wheelbase 2700 mm (106.29 in).
by drive select mode. Overall length 4780 mm (188.18 in).
Tires (standard) Pirelli 255/35 ZR19 (front) – 335/30 ZR20 (rear). Overall width (excluding mirrors) 2030 mm (79.92 in).
Rims (standard) 19‘‘x9J (front) - 20‘‘ x 12J (rear). Overall width (including mirrors) 2265 mm (89.17 in).
Tires (optional) Pirelli 255/30 ZR20 (front) – 355/25 ZR21 (rear). Overall height 1136 mm (44.72 in).
Rims (optional) 20‘‘x9J (front) - 21‘‘ x 13J (rear). Dry weight 1625 kg (3582 lb).
Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 12.5 m (41.01 ft). Weight distribution (front – rear) 43% - 57%.
Mirrors External mirror electrically foldable.
Rear spoiler Moveable – 3 positions depending on speed and drive select mode.
Airbags Front dual stage driver airbag and front adaptive passenger airbag;
seats with side “head-thorax” airbags; passenger and driver
knee airbags.
